title: Altar of whole stones on Ebal
english: After Ai [[Jesus builds an altar to God on Mount Ebal of whole stones untouched by iron >> Bible:Joshua 8:30-31]] — the law written on stones. Burnt offering and peace offerings. True worship’s form after enemies fall.

added_allusions.reason: altar on Ebal; law on stones

translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Blessing and curse between the mountains
english: [[All Israel, elders, scribes, and judges stand on both sides of the ark — half toward Gerizim for blessing, half toward Ebal for curse >> Bible:Joshua 8:33]]. Sojourner and native alike. The whole law must be heard.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Gibeonites’ deceit and covenant
english: The Gibeonites craftily make a covenant with dry bread and burst wineskins — a lie from fear of death. Leaders swear; the people murmur. Yet the oath must be kept. They become [[woodcutters and water-carriers for the house of God >> Bible:Joshua 9:21-27]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: No city made peace except Gibeon
english: [[No city made peace with Israel except the Gibeonites; the rest went to war >> Bible:Joshua 11:19]]. Peace with Jesus comes only through confession and service. Glory. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
